name: Frame
description: Customizable Jellyfin browser client. Original Jellyfin Web stays available.

versions.changelog: Improve playback controls, subtitles, custom fonts and reusable tags. Add compact ticket-style Watch and Resume buttons, smoother transitions and a clearer offline screen. Automatically fill missing display metadata and artwork through verified provider IDs while preserving existing edits. Expand artwork selection and filter images that exceed processing limits.
